## Type

- [ ] New skill
- [ ] Skill change
- [ ] Docs / registry / tooling

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run sync` passes (registry validated + regenerated)
- [ ] `npm run prettier:fix` applied
- [ ] For a new/renamed skill: folder name equals frontmatter `name`
- [ ] `description` is pushy with explicit EN + DE trigger phrases
- [ ] README skill table updated (hand-maintained; `npm run sync` fails if a skill has no row)
